verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents a first-party self-hosted binary that runs on your own hardware, with local embeddings and a local LLM, so 'your data never leaves the building'. That gives residency control by letting you pick the deployment location. There is no evidence of choosing a storage region or residency on the hosted platform. Missing for 10: region selection for hosted/cloud data, documented data-residency commitments (e.g. EU/US), independent corroboration of self-host residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Supermemory runs on your own hardware.
Local graph engine, local embeddings, local LLM. Your data never leaves the building.
